pretreatments.description: Alkaline pretreatment using NaOH solutions (0.2%, 0.4%, 0.6%, 0.8% w/v) at temperatures of 37 °C for 3 hours.
Photocatalytic pretreatment using TiO_2 nanoparticles (0.3, 0.4, 0.5, 0.6 g/L) in an enclosed chamber with UV-B lamps at 37 °C for 3 hours.
Alkaline-photocatalytic pretreatment combining the above conditions.
Sample preparation involving thickening and dewatering using a sand drying bed prior to storage.
